name: Adversarial robustness benchmark for EEG-based BCI
description: A benchmark that measures the adversarial robustness of EEG-based brain–computer interface models under various attack types and defenses.
evaluation_method: robust accuracy (classification accuracy under specified attacks) and attack success rate (adversarial success)
general_score_metric: robust accuracy (accuracy under attack); often reported alongside attack success rate
typical_sota_score: varies widely depending on attack/defense (commonly large drops from clean accuracy; examples range ~30–90% depending on setup)
reputation: A niche research benchmark used by ML security and BCI communities to study adversarial threats to EEG-based systems; adoption is limited to specialized research groups.
notes: Non‑LLM benchmark focused on EEG/BCI; results strongly affected by dataset size, subject variability, preprocessing, and attack threat model; reproducibility can be sensitive to signal processing and implementation details.
